title: Barua Sagar Lake Jhansi, History, Viewpoints, Timings & Travel Guide
content:
Barua Sagar Lake Jhansi,

Barua Sagar Lake is one of the most scenic locations in the Jhansi region, offering quiet views, open spaces, and a slower pace than the busy streets of the city. The lake was formed by Barua Sagar Dam, originally built in the 18th century under Raja Udit Singh of Orchha. Over time, it became a popular escape for locals and travelers who want calm surroundings, sunsets, and a natural stop between heritage sites.

History of Barua Sagar Lake

The history of Barua Sagar Lake dates back to the early 18th century. The lake and its embankment were constructed by Raja Udit Singh of Orchha between 1705 and 1707 CE. The purpose of the lake was water conservation and irrigation, a common practice among Bundela rulers. Over the centuries, the lake became an important landmark in the Bundelkhand region. The nearby Barua Sagar Fort was built as a summer retreat for the rulers of Orchha. The fort witnessed several historical events and battles, including conflicts involving Bundelas and Marathas. Today, the fort and lake together form one of the most picturesque heritage sites near Jhansi.

What to Expect When You Visit:

Expect open scenery, reflections of the sky on the water, and a simple break from city life. There are viewpoints near the lake walls, spots for walking, and open areas to sit quietly. The atmosphere changes through the day - beauty in the mornings, brighter and warmer at noon, and often photogenic around sunset. The lake isn’t heavily commercial, so don’t expect busy cafes or tourist vendors.

Best Time to Visit Barua Sagar Lake:

Late afternoon to sunset is the most rewarding time for both comfort and photography, Winter months give clearer views and pleasant weather, Avoid midday in peak summer unless you’re ready for strong sun.

How to Reach:

Barua Sagar Lake is located about 24 km from Jhansi, roughly 30- 40 minutes by road. Hiring an auto, taxi, or private vehicle is the simplest way. Public transport options are limited, especially in the evenings.

Nearby Places to Combine With Your Visit:

  • Jarai ka Math - ancient sandstone temple with carvings and early Pratihara design
  • Jhansi Fort - history and city views
  • Karguvanji Jain Temple - peaceful religious stop
  • Rani Mahal - heritage building with museum collection

This makes a complete day mixing history, nature, and reflection.

Entry Fee

  • Lake Area: Free
  • Nearby attractions may have separate entry charges if applicable.

Fees may change over time, so it's advisable to check locally before visiting.

Why You Should Visit:

Barua Sagar Lake is a simple but memorable stop - not crowded, not noisy, and not rushed. It’s for visitors who want scenery without too much planning, a quiet break between heritage visits, and a sunset that feels natural, not staged. If your Jhansi trip needs balance between history and calm, this lake delivers it.
excerpt: Barua Sagar Lake is a scenic water body near Jhansi, known for its sunset views, peaceful surroundings, and historic bund built over 250 years ago. It’s ideal for photography, picnics, and combining with nearby heritage sites like Jarai-ka-Math. Visit for calm views and a relaxed break from the city.

faqs.answer: Boating may be available occasionally, depending on local arrangements and water conditions.

faqs.question: How can I reach Barua Sagar Lake?
faqs.answer: You can reach by road from Jhansi. The nearest railway station is Jhansi Junction railway station.

faqs.question: Where is Barua Sagar Lake located?
faqs.answer: Barua Sagar Lake is located about 22-24 km from Jhansi in Uttar Pradesh.

faqs.question: Is there an entry fee for Barua Sagar Lake?
faqs.answer: No, visiting the lake area is generally free.

faqs.question: Why is Barua Sagar Lake famous?
faqs.answer: It is famous for its historic fort, artificial lake, scenic sunset views, Bundela heritage, and peaceful atmosphere.
